attr.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies
attr.desc: A survival-horror wave shooter based on the Android release of Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies.
attr.inst: Requires the Android APK. Copy it to ports/codboz/apk/game.apk, then launch the port to run first-launch setup.
attr.inst_md:
### Android APK Instructions
Copy your legally owned Android APK to `ports/codboz/apk/game.apk`, then launch the port. First launch extracts the Marmalade payload, downloads the required game resource archives, and prepares `ports/codboz/assets`.
